sources.entry: PassIt - Simple password manage with sharing features by group and user, but no administration interface. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.name: Passit
summary.one_liner: Passit is an open source, self-hostable password manager for storing passwords and secure notes, with group-based sharing.
use_cases: Sharing passwords with family or team members
Migrating passwords in or out via CSV
Running a private password manager on your own server
summary.what_it_does: Passit stores passwords and secure notes and lets users organize them into groups. On a self-hosted instance, users can be added to groups to share passwords with each other. It offers access across platforms and browsers, along with browser extensions. Passwords can be imported and exported as CSV files, and they can be read while offline. The project is developed by Burke Software and Consulting and is open source.
notable: Self-hosted instance with group-based password sharing
CSV import and export of passwords
caveats: awesome-selfhosted notes it has no administration interface
